positive: An interface needs purposeful transition, feedback, choreography, or reduced-motion behavior.
negative: The request is only static visual styling or decorative animation without an interaction purpose.

exclusions: Do not add motion without a user-facing purpose.
Do not make reduced motion a blank or broken experience.
Do not animate essential content into invisibility.

outputs.primary: purposeful motion choreography and token plan

stop_conditions: Stop when no purpose or interruption policy exists.
Stop when motion would compromise accessibility or performance without an approved tradeoff.
